data.title: Getting Around — Starter · Lesson 2
data.subject: directions
data.lyrics:
[Intro]
Alright now, let's get moving!

[Hook]
Let's go… Vamos
Wait for the train… Esperar el tren
Go by bus… Ir en autobús
Cross the street… Cruzar la calle
Get off the train… Bajar del tren
Get on the subway… Subir al metro

[Verse]
Birthday party, music's loud
We're dancing now, feeling proud
Turn left… Girar a la izquierda
Follow the arrow… Seguir la flecha
Wait at the stop… Esperar en la parada
There it is… Allí está
Left side… Lado izquierdo
There we go… Allá vamos

[Hook]
Let's go… Vamos
Wait for the train… Esperar el tren
Go by bus… Ir en autobús
Cross the street… Cruzar la calle
Get off the train… Bajar del tren
Get on the subway… Subir al metro

[Verse]
Balloon strings, colorful lights
Laughter and joy, feeling so right
Wait for the train… Esperar el tren
Meet new friends, start again
Go by bus… Ir en autobús
Adventure's calling, let's discuss
Cross the street… Cruzar la calle
Safety first, that's the key

[Bridge]
From the train to the bus we go
